mapper.select: SELECT att.company_code, att.atten_code, att.user_id, att.work_date, att.attend_type, attendType.code_name AS attend_type_name, att.created_by, att.create_date, att.updated_by, att.update_date FROM tb_attendance att JOIN tb_cm_code attendType ON att.attend_type = attendType.code WHERE work_date BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{month}, 'yyyy-MM') AND LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(#{month}, 'yyyy-MM')) ORDER BY work_date
